Roth.isPrimitive_linear✝ {h : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hcop : IsCoprime h ↑q) :
  (Polynomial.C ↑q * Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C h).IsPrimitive

private theorem Roth.isPrimitive_linear : ∀ {h : ℤ} {q : ℕ},
  IsCoprime h ↑q → (Polynomial.C ↑q * Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C h).IsPrimitive :=
fun {h} {q} hcop c hc ↦
  IsCoprime.isUnit_of_dvd' hcop
    (Eq.mp
      (Eq.trans
        (congrArg (Dvd.dvd c)
          (Eq.trans
            (Eq.trans
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg DFunLike.coe
                  (congrArg Polynomial.coeff
                    (congr
                      (congrArg HSub.hSub (congrFun' (congrArg HMul.hMul (map_natCast Polynomial.C q)) Polynomial.X))
                      (eq_intCast Polynomial.C h))))
                0)
              (Polynomial.coeff_sub (↑q * Polynomial.X) (↑h) 0))
            (Eq.trans
              (congr
                (congrArg HSub.hSub
                  (Eq.trans (Polynomial.mul_coeff_zero (↑q) Polynomial.X)
                    (Eq.trans
                      (congr
                        (congrArg HMul.hMul
                          (Eq.trans Polynomial.coeff_natCast_ite
                            (congrArg Nat.cast (ite_eq_left_of_eq_true q 0 (eq_self 0)))))
                        Polynomial.coeff_X_zero)
                      (mul_zero ↑q))))
                Polynomial.intCast_coeff_zero)
              (zero_sub h))))
        dvd_neg._simp_1)
      (Eq.mp
        (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a)
          (propext (Polynomial.C_dvd_iff_dvd_coeff c (Polynomial.C ↑q * Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C h))))
        hc 0))
    (Eq.mp
      (congrArg (Dvd.dvd c)
        (Eq.trans (Polynomial.coeff_sub (Polynomial.C ↑q * Polynomial.X) (Polynomial.C h) 1)
          (Eq.trans
            (congr
              (congrArg HSub.hSub
                (Eq.trans (Polynomial.coeff_C_mul Polynomial.X)
                  (Eq.trans (congrArg (HMul.hMul ↑q) Polynomial.coeff_X_one) (mul_one ↑q))))
              (Eq.trans Polynomial.coeff_C (ite_eq_right_of_eq_false h 0 Roth.isPrimitive_linear._simp_1_1✝)))
            (sub_zero ↑q))))
      (Eq.mp
        (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a)
          (propext (Polynomial.C_dvd_iff_dvd_coeff c (Polynomial.C ↑q * Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C h))))
        hc 1))
